text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ryan gets injured during training,
so I rush
her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer... I think I went at it a
little too
hard today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hah... To think I can't even take care of
my own
body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
If McQueen ever found out, she'd be so
upset
with me...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's rare to see her so timid, so I struggle
to find
the right words to say.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Take it easy, huh... I guess I should...
choice_data_list: 焦らずしっかり治せばいい
choice_data_list_en: Don't rush, just make sure you heal up properly.
Sickness is all in the mind!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I need to stop being a crybaby
about it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ryan uses both hands to slap her cheeks
and
psych herself up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: All right, time to change gears!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Actually... some running practice would
really hit
the spot right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, wait, running's out of the question
right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've gotta be... patient...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to get back to training at full
speed,
Ryan takes the day off to rest her
body.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
S-sorry, you're right. My thoughts are all
jumbled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, pain's all in the mind... All in the
mind...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
As someone who's always bursting with
energy,
it'd be wrong for me to show
weakness, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I rushed her return, her

condition the next day doesn't improve
at all.
Recovering is going to take even
longer now...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Rushing's no good, so maybe I should do

something to change my mood...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me, isn't the latest
volume out today?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's nothing! Haha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(Oh yeah, the last volume ended with a
big love
reveal! I wonder what happens
next!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(I'll read some manga tonight to cheer
myself up!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ryan is somehow her usual energetic self
again
the next day and is able to resume
training.
